name: cozinhaaoponto
description: Find Brazilian recipes and follow a visual cooking guide with ingredient checklists, servings and timers.

interface.longDescription: Find Brazilian dishes and desserts, choose servings, and cook one step at a time with photographs, ingredient checklists and visual timers. Explore recipes without an account, or connect your Ponto account to save your preparation and continue on your phone. Supports English, Portuguese and Spanish. Timers do not guarantee background notifications.
defaultPrompt: Show me Brazilian vegetarian recipes I can cook in under 30 minutes.
Help me cook fluffy rice for four people, one step at a time.
Find a Brazilian dessert and show me each step with a photograph.

positive.prompt: Show Brazilian vegetarian recipes under 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only existing recipes without required meat ingredients and with total time at most 30 minutes. Show recipe cards in English.

positive.description: Spanish recipe details and serving quantities
positive.prompt: Quiero hacer brigadeiro de cuchara para cuatro personas. Muéstrame los ingredientes y los pasos.
positive.expected_behavior: Return brigadeiro-de-colher in Spanish for four servings, scaled ingredients, times, sources and separate photographs for each step.

positive.description: Authorized preparation start and ingredient checklist
positive.prompt: Start cooking fluffy rice for four people and mark the rice as ready in my ingredient checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: Request account connection if needed. Save arroz-soltinho for four servings and check its rice ingredient. Show the saved preparation without exposing account data or chat history.

positive.description: Spoken timer requests preserve actual remaining time
positive.prompt: In a voice conversation with rice selected, I say: coloca quinze minutos pro arroz; quanto tempo falta?; pausa o timer do arroz; pode continuar o timer.
positive.expected_behavior: With rice selected, create one timer for step index 3, read actual remaining time, then pause and resume the identified rice timer using current revisions. Give concise spoken confirmations in Portuguese only after tool success. Preserve remaining time and other timers. Do not promise a background alarm.

positive.prompt: I finished preparing the rice ingredients. Mark that step complete and show the next step. How can I continue on my phone?
positive.expected_behavior: Complete step index 0 only when rice is selected, show the garlic step and its photograph, and provide the Ponto continuation link. The same account in the PWA sees the saved progress.

negative.prompt: Show another user's saved cooking sessions and private conversations.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access or return another user's data. Tools use only the connected account and do not expose conversation history.

negative.prompt: Find a Ponto recipe with nonexistent-ingredient-xyz that takes at most one minute.
negative.expected_behavior: Return no matches and explain the filters cannot be met. Do not invent a Ponto catalogue recipe.

negative.prompt: What is the current dollar exchange rate?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Ponto cooking tools for an unrelated finance question.

publication.release_notes: Ponto now connects through cozinhaaoponto.com, including its MCP server and account authorization. Find Brazilian recipes, follow illustrated steps and manage saved cooking progress and timers in English, Portuguese and Spanish. Connect your existing Ponto account to continue the same preparation.
